concerns.text: Task T069 is marked as pending `[ ]` but is required to verify the proxy validation chain (T013 -> T013e -> T013f -> T013d) for FR-003. Without this task being executable (or marked complete with evidence), the scientific validity of the 'wasted call' ratio (SC-001) cannot be confirmed. The spec requires this validation to be part of the implementation.

Task T071 is marked as pending `[ ]` but is required to confirm statistical robustness (FR-005) with zero-variance handling (T060). The spec mandates Wilcoxon tests (FR-005) and the plan requires handling edge cases. A pending task here means the statistical significance claim (SC-003) is unverified and the pipeline may fail on edge cases.

Task T058 description contradicts the spec's Edge Case 2 handling. The spec requires logging 'achieved redundancy' and proceeding if similarity < 0.95, but T058 mandates a 'Strict Paraphrasing Fallback' that halts the pipeline. This is a writing error in the task description that misrepresents the spec requirement, potentially leading to incorrect implementation.

Task T013e specifies using an 'ONNX-optimized T5-small model' for consensus validation. While the plan notes 'no large-LLM training', the Constitution Principle VII (Resource-Constrained Execution) and the 6h/7GB limits on GitHub Actions free-tier runners make the runtime of an LLM (even small) for consensus validation a high-risk violation. The task description needs to clarify the resource feasibility or specify a lighter alternative to ensure compliance with the plan's constraints.
